summary_ru: Чтение, создание уровней с планами этажей (пропуск дублей в пределах 5 мм) и параметрических координационных осей.
summary_en: Lists datums, creates levels with optional floor plans (5mm duplicate tolerance), and generates explicit or spaced grid arrays.
actions_list: list: Lists all levels sorted by elevation and grids with coordinates. | create_levels: Creates levels and optional floor plans (5mm duplicate tolerance). | create_grids: Creates explicit grids or parametric xSpacingsMm / ySpacingsMm grid layouts.

title_ru: Стены, перекрытия, потолки, шахты и помещения
summary_ru: Полный цикл архитектурного каркаса: список системных типов с толщиной, возведение стен, перекрытий с проёмами, потолков, шахт и расстановка помещений.
summary_en: Core architectural modeling: lists system family types with thickness, creates polyline walls, floors with openings, ceilings, shafts, and rooms.
actions_list: list_types: Lists Walls, Floors, Ceilings, and Roofs types with thickness (mm). | create_walls: Creates walls from segments or a closed polyline perimeter. | create_floors: Creates floor slabs by boundary points or rectangle plus inner openings. | create_ceilings: Creates ceilings by boundary sketch and height offset from level. | create_shaft_opening: Creates a vertical shaft opening spanning baseLevel to topLevel. | create_rooms: Places rooms inside enclosed boundaries by (x, y), name, and number.

summary_ru: Подбор типоразмеров конструктива, автоматическая расстановка колонн на всех пересечениях осей и построение балок.
summary_en: Lists structural column/framing types, places columns across grid intersections automatically, and builds beams.
actions_list: list_types: Lists loaded structural/architectural column and framing types. | create_columns: Places columns explicitly or automatically at all grid intersections. | create_beams: Creates beams by start/end coordinates on level with zOffsetMm.

summary_ru: Поиск в локальных библиотеках (3 237 English / 29 Russian .rfa), тихая загрузка без окон Revit и пакетная вставка свободных и зависимых экземпляров.
summary_en: Searches disk libraries (3,237 English / 29 Russian .rfa), loads families without UI prompts, and batch-places unhosted/hosted instances.
actions_list: scan_rfa_files: Scans disk folders for .rfa families (English 3237 / Russian 29). | list_loaded: Lists loaded FamilySymbols in the active model with placementType. | load_family: Silently loads a .rfa file via IFamilyLoadOptions and activates symbols. | place_unhosted: Batch-places unhosted instances (furniture, fixtures) with rotation & params. | place_hosted: Batch-places hosted instances (doors, windows) on hostId by t (0..1) or XY.

summary_ru: Детальная инспекция геометрии и 40 параметров, выделение в окне Revit, перемещение, поворот, тиражирование по этажам и безопасное удаление.
summary_en: Inspects geometry, bounding boxes, and up to 40 parameters, selects in UI, moves, rotates, copies across levels, and deletes elements.
actions_list: inspect_elements: Returns location, bounding box, and up to 40 parameters by IDs or selection. | select_in_ui: Selects specified element IDs inside the Revit UI. | move: Translates elements by (dxMm, dyMm, dzMm). | rotate: Rotates elements around axis (cxMm, cyMm) by angleDeg. | copy_to_levels: Copies elements from sourceLevel to targetLevels or allLevelsAbove. | delete: Deletes specified element IDs cleanly inside one transaction.

title_en: Views, PNG Export, 3D Camera & Reference Images
summary_ru: Экспорт видов, настройка 3D-камер по пресетам, импорт чертежей-подложек, управление SectionBox и недеструктивный рендер 4 ракурсов.
summary_en: Exports views to PNG, sets preset 3D cameras, imports plan reference images, toggles selection SectionBox, and runs 4-angle Quad renders.
actions_list: list_views: Lists exportable views filtered by viewType. | export_view_png: Exports the active or named view to PNG for verification. | set_3d_camera: Sets 3D camera using presets (iso_se, front, etc.) or eye/target coordinates. | import_reference_image: Imports a scaled reference PNG/JPG overlay into a 2D view. | section_box_selection: Crops 3D SectionBox around selection/elementIds with paddingMm. | reset_section_box: Disables active SectionBox and optionally zooms to fit. | export_quad_png: Non-destructive 4-view PNG render (iso_se, iso_nw, front, top) via RollBack.

summary_ru: Автоматический поиск непрямоугольных угловых ячеек наклонных витражей, генерация подрезанных 3D-ламелей (шаг 125 мм DirectShape) и откат.
summary_en: Inspects non-rectangular corner panels on slanted curtain walls, generates mitered 125mm DirectShape louver blades, or reverts cleanly.
actions_list: inspect: Detects non-rectangular panels and checks blade phasing against Lover Panel_Mech. | apply: Generates trimmed 125mm DirectShape blades and swaps source panel to Empty. | revert: Removes generated DirectShape blades and restores original panels.

summary_ru: Кластеризация предупреждений Revit, выделение проблемных элементов, диагностика помещений и проверка пересечений геометрии между категориями.
summary_en: Clusters Revit warnings, selects offending elements, audits unplaced/redundant/duplicate rooms, and runs 3D category clash detection.
actions_list: warnings_summary: Groups warnings by type; exports full JSON report if >20 items. | select_warning: Selects and zooms to elements matching groupIndex or query substring. | check_rooms: Detects unplaced, redundant, unenclosed, and duplicate-numbered rooms. | delete_unplaced_rooms: Removes all unplaced rooms (Location == null) in a single transaction. | clash_check: Checks 3D intersections between categoryA and categoryB (unjoined pairs).

summary_ru: Контроль заполнения марок и огнестойкости, геометрическая нумерация по этажам/осям, синхронизация параметров и выгрузка таблиц в CSV.
summary_en: Audits parameter completeness & duplicates, spatially renumbers elements, syncs levels/rooms, and exports schedules to UTF-8 BOM CSV.
actions_list: audit_params: Audits empty values and duplicates on instance/type parameters. | auto_renumber: Renumbers selection or category sorted by Level → X (500mm) → Y → ID. | sync_params: Syncs level names, room names, or copies arbitrary parameter values. | export_schedules: Exports ViewSchedules to semicolon-delimited UTF-8 BOM CSV files.

summary_ru: Аудит неверного порядка резки, массовое соединение перекрытий, колонн, балок и стен по пресету arch_standard и безопасное разъединение.
summary_en: Inspects join status & cut priority, batch-joins elements with architectural cut precedence (arch_standard), or unjoins selections.
actions_list: inspect_joins: Analyzes category intersections: valid, reversed cut order, or unjoined. | auto_join: Runs arch_standard join & cut order (Floors > Columns > Beams > Walls). | unjoin_selection: Cleanly unjoins all joined geometry on selected or given elementIds.

title_ru: Здоровье модели, сброс графики и чистка видов
title_en: Model Health, View Overrides & Unused View Purge
summary_ru: Комплексный чек-лист здоровья проекта (DWG/RVT-связи, In-Place, DirectShape, группы), сброс переопределений графики и безопасная чистка видов.
summary_en: Generates a full model health snapshot (CAD/RVT links, In-Place, DirectShape, groups), resets view overrides, and safely purges unused views.
actions_list: model_health: Audits warnings, CAD/RVT links, In-Place, DirectShape, groups, views & filters. | reset_view_overrides: Resets manual per-element graphics overrides on active or target view. | list_unused_views: Lists views not placed on sheets (protects {3D}, active view, templates). | purge_unused_views: Safely deletes unplaced views (defaults to dryRun: true preview mode).
